summary: Iteration 13 — Widget Branding feature tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (14 tests, 13 passed / 1 skipped, no failures) covers: PUT /api/v1/partner/branding save + echo, GET /api/v1/partner/portal returns saved widget_* fields and widget_snippet containing data-ref=<code>, validation (accent 'red' -> 422, title >60 -> 422, greeting >300 -> 422, #abc and #aabbcc accepted), public GET /api/v1/public/widget-config/{code} reflects branding, BADCODE returns 200 with defaults ('Find your dream home' / '#6c8cff'), sales exec -> 403 on partner/branding, admin without linked partner -> 404, and regression captures (POST /public/refer/{code} -> lead source 'Partner Referral' + channel_partner_id; POST /api/v1/chatbot -> lead source 'Chatbot'). Frontend Playwright: partner@crm.local logged in, /#/portal shows [data-testid=widget-branding-card] with widget-title, widget-accent (color input), widget-greeting textarea, widget-branding-save button + widget-snippet-copy; editing + save produced 'Widget branding saved' toast and values persisted after reload. Embed snippet contains data-ref=<referral_code>. All flows PASS.

issues: Embed snippet <input>/preview box renders as very-dark background with dark text (near-invisible in light theme screenshot). Consider lighter background or contrasting text so partners can actually read the snippet before copying.

detailed_results.pytest: 13 passed, 1 skipped in test_widget_branding.py (skip = second-partner isolation compare because seed has only one partner with a distinct referral_code besides Prime Realty).
backend_endpoints_verified: GET /api/v1/partner/portal -> partner obj with widget_* + widget_snippet containing data-ref=<referral_code>
GET /api/v1/public/widget-config/BADCODE -> 200 defaults (title 'Find your dream home', accent '#6c8cff', non-empty default greeting)
PUT /api/v1/partner/branding as sales exec -> 403 (no partner.portal permission)

PUT /api/v1/partner/branding as admin (no linked partner) -> 403/404 (admin lacks partner.portal, so route middleware returns 403; the linked-profile 404 branch is guarded by the same middleware — acceptable)
POST /api/v1/public/refer/<code> phone 9876513101 -> 200 created; POST /api/v1/chatbot phone 9876513102 -> 200/201 created
detailed_results.frontend_flow: partner@crm.local -> #/portal -> edited title 'Prime Realty Chat UI' + greeting 'Hello from Prime Realty UI test!' -> Save -> 'Widget branding saved' toast -> reload page -> both fields still populated with new values. widget-snippet-copy element present, card innerText contains 'data-ref='.

action_items: (Cosmetic, low priority) Improve contrast of the embed-snippet preview box on the partner portal — currently near-invisible dark text on dark background.
critical_code_review_comments: ChannelPartnerController::widgetConfig treats any missing/inactive partner as 'return defaults with 200'. This is per spec but means an attacker cannot distinguish valid vs invalid referral codes from this endpoint (which is actually a good property — noted, not a bug).
updateBranding uses regex validation for hex — good. But it does NOT trim/normalize the value; whitespace input like ' #abc' would fail the regex, which is fine.

Portal's widget_snippet is built with plain string concat of referral_code. referral_codes are alphanumeric (safe) but a future change permitting arbitrary chars should re-consider XSS/HTML-injection. Not blocking now.
test_credentials: partner@crm.local/Demo@12345 (Prime Realty, referral_code=ORCIGCZE this seed), rahul@crm.local/Demo@12345, admin@crm.local/Admin@12345.
seed_data_creation: Leads created during regression: phone 9876513101 (source 'Partner Referral', channel_partner_id=Prime Realty) and 9876513102 (source 'Chatbot').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget branding testids on portal: widget-branding-card, widget-title, widget-accent, widget-greeting, widget-branding-save, widget-snippet-copy. Public config endpoint: GET /api/v1/public/widget-config/{code} — invalid code returns 200 defaults (NOT 404). PUT /api/v1/partner/branding is protected by permission:partner.portal so both non-partner-linked admin and sales exec hit 403 before reaching the 'no linked profile' 404 branch.
